coordinator_review.reviewer: root AI source/context review; not human voice validation

purpose: Predeclared response anchors for checking reviewer discrimination and disagreements; not assistant performance or a calibrated human preference model.
label_scope: Factual and explicit-instruction references are stronger anchors. Voice, warmth and emotional-fit references remain provisional AI judgments even after AI coordinator review.
change_policy: Freeze this version and the complete dataset hash before independent review. Preserve observed reviews unchanged. Content corrections require a new reference version and a fresh hash-bound comparison; retain earlier disagreements.

extension.review_reuse_policy: Prior v1 reviews remain immutable. Reuse unchanged judgments only with explicit per-item blind-input and rubric hash verification plus prior-review provenance; reused judgments are not fresh v2 ratings.
